verdict.rationale: Muse's docs describe delegating multi-step tasks/goals that run autonomously in the background on a schedule, taking follow-up steps, building tools as needed, and surfacing a Goals tab with activity logs and approval cards for review — directly matching the story. This is corroborated by first-party sources (docs and official blog) though independent hands-on validation is thinner and one community report notes control-plane timeouts under stress. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of successful end-to-end task completion and review workflow, and more detail on how review/approval interplays with autonomous execution at scale.
